decision.observation: Turn 2 begins with 70/80 HP, 3 energy, and Inflame, two Strikes, Bash, and Defend in hand. The Jaw Worm has 37/43 HP and a 7-damage attack/block intent.
decision.hypothesis: Playing Inflame now will add 2 Strength to all subsequent attacks for the rest of combat, enabling both Strikes to deal 8 damage this turn.
decision.memory: Jaw Worm turn 1: one Strike and two Defends; the 12-damage attack was reduced to 2. Inflame is a 1-cost Power granting 2 Strength.
